correctness.rationale: The gauge is exact. On any positive trajectory away from the carrying-capacity surface, divide the prey and predator equations by the corresponding state and solve pointwise for the two free time-varying rates after choosing any admissible constant interaction triple. Substitution recovers the original derivatives identically for both the Holling type-II and ratio-dependent denominators. Even without the prey reconstruction, changing the conversion constant can always be absorbed by the free predator-death function. Positivity survives sufficiently small parameter changes at an interior positive representation by continuity. The assigned numerical script is only a roundoff-level illustration of this exact algebra.
